meta.title: B19: real monthly-reset funds against real daily-reset funds

banner: Inputs: 13 files; prices from <external>/library, rates from <external>/rates
Reference tables (reference/): 7 files (mutual_funds/: SEC filings, accession number on every row; Shiller's monthly S&P 500 yields; QQQ's fiscal-year income yields)
mutual_funds/highlights.csv: 271 rows, None to None, sha256 4460dc1a7daf
mutual_funds/anchors.csv: 503 rows, None to None, sha256 a6f7dc76e4bc
shiller_sp500_monthly.csv: 1830 rows, None to None, sha256 44414783f35b

Fund series: daily NAV from the price library (mutual-fund NAVs, distributions NOT included); filed splits the vendor did not apply are applied; distributions added back on ex-dates found in the NAV (navtr), reinvested at the ex-date NAV.

Model: index total return (series.py), financing (L - 1) x DFF lagged one row (TB3MS proxy where DFF is not yet published), ACT/360; filed net expense ratio per fiscal year, ACT/365; calendar funds reset at the last NYSE session of each month with no early reset (none filed); one fitted residual spread per NAV.
Checks from 2009-10-01 (or the fund's first filed regime); fits and real-vs-real to 2026-09-30.

rate.source: FRED DFF (effective fed funds), lagged one row; TB3MS proxy where DFF is not yet published

fits.label: sensitivity: from the end of the first full fiscal year (chosen AFTER the data showed the launch year does not track a 2x monthly fund: RMQHX lost 0.53% in Jan 2015 while the index fell 2.03%)

real_vs_real.label: sensitivity: from the end of the first full fiscal year (chosen AFTER the data showed the launch year does not track a 2x monthly fund: RMQHX lost 0.53% in Jan 2015 while the index fell 2.03%)
